That singing greeting card is cute. The battery inside it is not.

Button batteries hide in remotes, flameless candles, light-up toys and musical cards. Swallowed, one can burn through a child's food pipe within 2 hours.
Two small magnets can stick together inside the intestines.
Water beads can grow up to 100 times their size. With little ones at home, skip them.
Tape battery doors shut, follow age labels, and toss packaging right after unwrapping.

Save the battery hotline: 800-498-8666. If you think your child swallowed a battery, magnets or water beads, go to the ER or call 911.
